map.油墨消耗量（按覆盖率）估算 使用指南: Ink consumption (by coverage) estimation user guide
map.根据印刷面积、油墨覆盖率、墨膜厚度、油墨密度和印数估算油墨消耗量，支持单色与 C: Estimate ink consumption from print area, ink coverage, ink film thickness, ink density and print run; supports monochrome and CMYK four-color separations
map.印刷前按印面面积、油墨覆盖率、墨膜厚度、油墨密度与印数估算总墨量，提前备墨避免断: Before printing, estimate total ink from print area, ink coverage, ink film thickness, ink density and print run, to prepare ink in advance and avoid running out.
map.单色与 CMYK 四色分色分别估算，黑版实地覆盖高时总墨量显著上升，需重点核算。: Estimate monochrome and CMYK four-color separations separately; when the black plate solid coverage is high, total ink rises significantly and must be carefully accounted.
map.结合油墨单价算总成本，或在多个印件间调配剩余专色墨，控制耗材费用。: Combine ink unit price for total cost, or redistribute remaining spot ink across print jobs to control consumable expense.
map.以「单色：面积 0.5 m²、覆盖率 40%、墨膜厚 1.2 μm、密度 1.2: Example: "monochrome: area 0.5 m^2, coverage 40%, ink film 1.2 um, density 1.2 g/cm^3, print run 10,000, loss 5%"
map.：单张墨量=面积×覆盖率×墨膜厚×密度=0.5×0.40×1.2×1.2=0.2: : single-sheet ink = area x coverage x film thickness x density = 0.5 x 0.40 x 1.2 x 1.2 = 0.288 g. 1000 sheets = 288 g; net total ink = 0.288 x 10000 = 2880 g, with 5% loss = 3024 g = 3.024 kg, loss ink 144 g. If CMYK four-color coverage [40,30,25,90] (black solid 90%) is used, four-color total ink = 0.5 x ((0.40+0.30+0.25+0.90)/100) x 1.2 x 1.2 x 10000 x 1.05 / 1000 approx 13.99 kg, about 4.6x the monochrome, showing high black coverage's dominant effect on ink use.
map.单张墨量公式各量纲怎么约掉？: How to cancel units in the single-sheet ink formula?
map.面积(m²)×覆盖率(0~1)×墨膜厚(μm，即 10⁻⁶ m)×密度(g/cm: Area (m^2) x coverage (0-1) x ink film thickness (um, i.e. 10^-6 m) x density (g/cm^3=10^6 g/m^3) -> g. That is 0.5 x 0.40 x 1.2e-6 x 1.2e6 = 0.288 g, dimensions automatically reduce to grams. Note the product holds exactly when film thickness is in microns and density in g/cm^3.
map.损耗 5% 从哪来？: Where does the 5% loss come from?
map.指洗车、调墨、试印、管道残留等工艺损耗，单色常取 3%~5%，专色或浅色因清洗更: Refers to car wash, ink mixing, proofing, pipe residue and other process losses; monochrome often 3%-5%, spot or light colors, which need more cleaning, may take higher. It is multiplied on net ink by (1+loss%), not deducted from the print run.
